    • ` result.innerHTML += HTML } function calcAutoDeviceBuff(level, aspd, over8m, result) { var mpRecov = 100 var attackDelay = (1100 - aspd)/1000 if (attackDelay < 0) {attackDelay = 0} if (over8m) { mpRecov = 5 * level attackDelay += 1.5 - 0.1*level } if (Math.ceil(attackDelay*100)/100 - attackDelay < 0.0099) {attackDelay = Math.ceil(attackDelay*100)/100} else {attackDelay = Math.round(attackDelay*100)/100} HTML = `
